data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross prior year reserve release of GBP 3.502m in 2020, primarily driven by favourable development on the 2018 underwriting year as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. While the report notes a net favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m, the gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions. Specific causes for this overall release are not detailed, though the net LOB breakdown shows mixed development with favourable movements in Reinsurance and Marine aviation and transport, offset by adverse development in Fire and other damage to property.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development of -3.502m is calculated from the gross claims development triangle for the 2018 underwriting year. This differs from the narrative statement of 'favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m' which is explicitly stated as net of reinsurance. LOB movements are based on net figures from the report's 'Prior year claims development' table, as a gross breakdown was not available.
